colours.note: The Anordnung über die deutschen Flaggen (1996) names the colours (black, red, gold) and gives no values. The Bundestag's flag FAQ says the Reichstag's gold flags use RAL 1028. The same page records that the Interior Ministry said in 1998 it had fixed no technical shade.
